metadata.usc_dining_notes: USC hours are Regular Hours Aug 24-Dec 4, 2026 from hospitality.usc.edu/hours-of-operation/. Dining halls are all-you-care-to-eat: dish price is null and pricing_model is all_you_care_to_eat_meal_swipe - the real cost is 1 residential meal swipe (or the hall's cash door price, not in this dataset). Retail USC dish prices are ESTIMATES for demo budgeting - USC does not publish them on the location pages. Menus in dining halls rotate daily, so hall dishes are representative station items named on USC Hospitality pages, not a fixed daily menu.
metadata.coverage_note_v3: v0.3 adds the full off-campus sweep GK asked for: every food chain within ~1 mile (Chick-fil-A, McDonald's, Taco Bell, Carl's Jr. 24h, Domino's, Wingstop, Jersey Mike's, Which Wich, Subway 24h, Starbucks, Jimmy John's, Bruxie, Insomnia, Sunlife, Trejo's), all USC Village retail tenants found in Village listings, the Figueroa corridor, Vermont Ave, and Mercado La Paloma (Holbox, Chichen Itza, Komal, Vista Hermosa). Entries whose hours are marked 'typical hours - NOT individually verified' in opening_hours.source are Village tenants confirmed by tenant lists but not individually hour-checked in this pass. Named in area listings but NOT included (no verified address/hours found in this pass): Little Pan USC, California Gogi Korean Grill, Skywalker Grill (Exposition Park), 23rd Street Cafe, Ebaes, South LA Cafe (appears >1 mile). Second locations of the same chain inside the radius are noted on the primary entry instead of duplicated (Subway 3335 S Figueroa, McDonald's 4000 S Figueroa is outside at ~1.1 mi).
metadata.coverage_note_v4: V4 (GK-directed, location-by-location): every name GK listed on 2026-11-15 was resolved - Manas, Taco Bell, Pasta Roma, Dominos, Subway, sweetgreen, CAVA, Softies, Jimmy John's and Cafe Dulce were already in; Olympian Burgers (his 'Olympia Burger'), Tacos El Unico (Adams), Thai by Trio, Five Guys (530 W 27th St), Blaze Pizza (3335 S Figueroa) and Viztango Cafe were added. The earlier gap sweep also added Skywalker Grill + Lucas Museum Lobby Cafe (Exposition Park), Ebaes, Little Pan USC, Cafe 23, Spudnuts Donuts (24h), Nature's Brew and Dirt Dog (flagged status-uncertain). RESOLVED EXCLUSIONS, verified 2026-11-15: California Gogi Korean Grill's LA location is permanently closed and its 3742 S Figueroa address is now Little Pan USC; Dog Haus Biergarten USC (3335 S Figueroa) is permanently closed per its Places record. Remaining known limits: mobile food trucks and taco stands are not enumerated (they rotate), a handful of USC Village tenants still carry typical-hours flags, and Dirt Dog's operating status conflicts across sources.
metadata.coverage_note_v5: V5 completeness audit (2026-11-15, after GK asked twice whether ALL nearby restaurants were in): corridor-by-corridor audit of Figueroa, Vermont, Jefferson, Adams/Union, MLK, Exposition Park and USC Village tenant lists, cross-checked against USC's own 'Where To Eat On and Near Campus' guide and delivery-platform store lists. Audit ADDED: Ono Hawaiian BBQ, Little Caesars (MLK), KOBUNGA Korean Grill, Northern Cafe, 901 Bar and Grill, Cup O' Joy, Dutch Bros Coffee, Yoboseyo! Superette, and Piara Pizza at its NEW Vermont Ave address. Audit RESOLVED as excluded, each verified 2026-11-15: Hart House USC - permanently closed chain-wide (Dutch Bros now occupies its 3726 S Figueroa address); 'El Pollo Loco 2258 S Vermont' - appears only in low-quality aggregators with another store's phone number and is NOT on El Pollo Loco's official locator (nearest official stores are 1.2+ mi away); Holy Green - real but at 1842 W Washington Blvd, 1.21 mi from the reference point, outside the radius; Piara Pizza's original Figueroa store - closed Aug 2, 2026 when it relocated (new location IS included); California Gogi and Dog Haus USC - permanently closed (from V4 audit). REMAINING known limits, stated honestly: mobile food trucks and rotating taco stands are not enumerated; a few USC Village tenants still carry typical-hours flags; Dirt Dog's status conflicts across sources; museum/venue concessions inside Exposition Park institutions other than the Lucas Museum are not enumerated.
metadata.menu_verification_policy: V6 menu pass (GK's instruction, 2026-11-15): dishes were checked against (1) official chain menus/apps and published chain nutrition patterns, (2) the restaurant's own online/delivery menus, and (3) menu photos, receipts and social posts ONLY when dated on or after 2025-11-15 (within one year). Dishes verified this way carry a menu_evidence object with source_type, source_detail, evidence_date and within_last_year=true. Dishes without menu_evidence are representative estimates from earlier passes and are labeled nutrition_source=estimated. Prices marked chain pattern / published_by_chain_pattern follow the chain's published pattern; local prices vary.
metadata.coverage_note_v6: V6 audit (2026-11-15, after GK said dishes were missed and no restaurant should be missed): re-audited the USC Village OFFICIAL tenant directory (uscvillage.com/directory), Yelp's Top 10 near USC, Tripadvisor nearby lists, the RoamRecs USC guide and the Tuscany on Fig retail row. ADDED 12 restaurants: Gogobop Korean Rice Bar (Village directory - it now occupies Kobunga's old Suite 1610), Pete's Burgers (Hoover, since 1972), QWENCH Juice Bar & DRNK (Hoover), La Chuperia (Flower St), Tenori onigiri and HEYTEA and Cold Stone Creamery (Tuscany row), Azao Sushi (late-night, Figueroa), Tirebiter Brewery (Figueroa), Neighborhood Grill by Post & Beam and South LA Cafe (both inside the Natural History Museum), and Little Galen (USC Hospitality athletics dining, open to the public, not on the UPC View All list). STATUS CORRECTIONS: Little Pan USC is reported closed (2026) and replaced by Tenori at the same address - its entry is flagged, not deleted; Kobunga is flagged as possibly replaced by Gogobop; 'Fertitta Cafe' is the same place as Chad Tons Family Cafe (Fertitta Hall), already in the USC set - Chad Tons' dishes were expanded from USC's own Nov 5, 2026 video. CHECKED AND EXCLUDED, each verified 2026-11-15: Figueroa Philly (permanently closed per Yelp live data), Pizza Studio USC (permanently closed), AhiPoki Bowl Figueroa (no listing newer than its 2016 opening), Cafecito de la Crepe (real but 1.38 mi away, outside radius), 'Galen Thai' (no such restaurant exists near USC - guide error), the 358 W 38th St delivery-only ghost-kitchen brands (Tacos by Dres, Monty's, Vietnamese Delight, Pad Thai Diva - no storefront), Harold & Belle's / El Valle Oaxaqueno / El Mana / Johnny's Pastrami (all 1.9+ mi west). DISHES: menu pass added ~70 dishes with menu_evidence (official chain menus/apps, Toast and merchant-set delivery menus, a photographed July 2026 receipt at QWENCH, USC Campus Dining's Nov 2026 Chad Tons video, Viztango's Sep 2026 Tuesday-deal post, Tenori's Jul-Aug 2026 opening coverage). Remaining honest limits: rotating food trucks/stands are not enumerated; a few Village tenants still carry typical-hours flags; Dirt Dog's status conflicts; South LA Cafe (NHM) is lightly verified.
